title: Mewra PreFlight Configuration
description: Configuration schema for Mewra PreFlight pre-push pipeline (.mewra-preflight.json)

$schema.description: Schema URI for autocompletion and validation

targetBranch.description: Default target git branch to diff against (e.g. main, develop, master)

universalChecks.description: Configuration for universal language-agnostic sanity checks

noDebugStatements.description: Severity for console.log and debugger statements

noSecrets.description: Severity for leaked API keys, tokens, or .env secrets

noMergeConflicts.description: Severity for unresolved git merge conflict markers

largeFileThresholdMb.description: Threshold in MB for flagging large newly added files (set to 0 to disable)

manualChecklist.description: Custom manual checklist items displayed before push & PR creation. Press Ctrl+Space to insert a template.

defaultSnippets.label: Manual Check (Conditional)
defaultSnippets.description: Add a manual verification item triggered when matching files are modified

body.label: ${2:Did you apply database migration to dev DB?}

defaultSnippets.label: Manual Check (Always Active)
defaultSnippets.description: Add a manual verification item shown on every PR

defaultSnippets.label: Manual Check (Conditional)
defaultSnippets.description: Triggered when files matching glob pattern are modified

id.description: Unique identifier for this manual check

label.description: Human-readable label / question displayed in dashboard

severity.description: Severity level. 'error' blocks push until checked; 'warning' displays a notice

condition.description: Optional condition determining when this check triggers

modifiedFilesMatch.description: Glob pattern matching changed files to trigger this check (e.g. 'prisma/migrations/**')

ecosystems.description: Configuration for ecosystem-specific check packs (e.g. js-ts, go, python)
